resources.string: Windy Weather uses your approximate location to fetch local weather. If you continue, rounded coordinates are sent over HTTPS to Open-Meteo when you refresh and automatically as often as every 15 minutes. Coordinates and weather details are stored locally until you turn this feature off. Open-Meteo may retain API logs containing coordinates for up to 90 days. Moon phase is calculated on this device. You can withdraw consent at any time in settings.
